findings.evidence: `rg -n "\[simp\]|isConstStructureJHolomorphic(At|WithinAt|On)?_(fst|snd|prodMk_left|prodMk_right)" JHolomorphicProd.lean` shows projection variants at lines 75-123 carry `@[simp]`, while the inclusion variants at lines 251-303 have no attribute.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp]` to all eight `prodMk_left`/`prodMk_right` inclusion lemmas at lines 251, 257, 264, 271, 278, 286, 293, and 300.
findings.issue: The public affine coordinate-inclusion facts `isConstStructureJHolomorphicAt_prodMk_left/right` and their within/on/global variants are premise-free normal-form lemmas but are not marked `@[simp]`, unlike the projection facts in the same file.

summary: The compatibility wrapper modules are present, but the new public coordinate-inclusion normal-form API is missing the same simp support as the parallel projection API.
